fcdf4ca5b1.why: The rounded scalar arithmetic, high-word broadcast, store, and required register initializations have no identified shorter equivalent within SSE4.1.

9f766cb8cc.why: Each vector needs its load, wrapping addition, two clamps with arbitrary input bounds, and store, while the pointer update and BTC result and carry must also be preserved.

11b1e36789.why: All four stores use required address expressions, and the live pointer decrement and comparison flags require separate instructions.

0b754ea9a4.why: The seven stores and flag-producing pointer subtraction are required, and SSE4.1 needs a copy followed by a shift to preserve xmm11 while producing xmm15.

b3c4248fff.why: The two rounded multiplications cannot be collapsed across the intervening arithmetic shift for arbitrary inputs, and the store, counter initialization, and final flags remain required.
